description: Measure decoded sample levels in a selected 1–30 second section of one video, optionally comparing another video. Reports RMS, peaks, near-full-scale sample counts and one-second windows for listening review. Does not identify a voice, prove clipping, measure perceptual loudness or verify lip sync. Video audio includes music and effects. An interval may be shorter than requested; check examinedSeconds. Never approves a paid render.
name: inspect_audio_levels
title: Inspect audio levels in one or two video clips
